messages:
micah (customer): Hey team — sudden 403 when our CI service tries to open the project console. Worked yesterday. API key test passes but UI shows 'permission denied'. Can you help? :grimace:
ashley (support): Sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste the root error from the console and the exact account you're using? Any recent IdP/SCIM changes?
micah (customer): Error in UI: '403: insufficient_project_permission'. Our service account is svc-ci@example.com. We did a SCIM update overnight to change group names, but we didn't touch role mappings explicitly.
ashley (support): Thanks. Can you run a quick check: from your side, curl the members endpoint so we can see effective role? Example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/orgs/0/members | jq '.[] | select(.email=="svc-ci@example.com")'
```
micah (customer): output below:
```
{
  "email": "svc-ci@example.com",
  "id": "sa-99822",
  "source": "scim",
  "member_type": "service_account",
  "mapped_role": "",
  "effective_role": "none",
  "remote_group": "ci-runners-v2"
}
```
micah (customer): note mapped_role is empty even though group maps to 'project-developer' in our idp mapping.
ashley (support): Hmm. @leo / @jordan can you weigh in? Looks like SCIM created a shadow member without assigning the role. Could be attribute truncation or claim rename.
leo (eng-identity): Thanks. Two things to check: 1) Did SCIM change the attribute name for roles (e.g., 'roles' -> 'role_list')? 2) Any char-length truncation on group names? We recently saw a bug where long group paths get truncated and mapping lookup fails.
jordan (idp-infra): We did a SCIM sync update yesterday to avoid long DN issues. We added a max-length sanitize step that can clip group names > 32 chars. If your remote_group was originally 'ci-runners-production-2025', it might be truncated to 'ci-runners-production-2' and mapping rule no longer matches.
micah (customer): our group is 'ci-runners-production-2025' — yep that's 27 chars though. But we use nested group path on Okta: 'eng/ci-runners-production-2025', maybe the sanitizer split or trimmed the prefix.
leo (eng-identity): That matches a known edge-case: when nested group paths include a slash, our SCIM normalizer converts '/'->'-' and then applies a 24-char clip for remote_group id used for mapping. If mapping rules were created against the full original string, they can fail. We'll confirm the sanitizer version.
ashley (support): Short-term workaround: we can add an ad-hoc mapping for the truncated remote_group or directly assign the project role to the service account via our admin API. Do you want a quick temporary grant so your CI can run?
micah (customer): yes please — need CI unblocked. Also would like steps so we can avoid this in future.
leo (eng-identity): I can do a temporary grant. Ashley, can you escalate to org-admin console to apply project role?
ashley (support): On it. @deploy-bot please create a temp grant task.
deploy-bot: Created task #T-4392 — temp role grant in progress.
ashley (support): I granted svc-ci@example.com a 'project-developer' on project:billing-portal for 4 hours. Please verify.
micah (customer): Verified — console access restored, CI back to green. Thanks.
leo (eng-identity): For the permanent fix: we'll 1) update SCIM normalizer to preserve slash->'/' mapping for lookup keys (no truncation) and 2) add a migration to re-run mapping resolution for recent shadow members where mapped_role=="". Jordan, can you schedule that?
jordan (idp-infra): I'll schedule a rolling resync and patch; ETA 48 hours. Will post a follow-up here when started.
micah (customer): appreciated. Also can you share how to check for other shadowed service accounts we might have?
leo (eng-identity): Run this admin query to find members missing mapped_role:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/orgs/0/members | jq '.[] | select(.mapped_role=="" and .source=="scim")'
```
ashley (support): I'll keep this thread open until the resync patch lands. If anything else breaks ping @support. :thumbsup:
